title: Convention Center Garage & Police Suits
summary:
*   The Austin City Council held a special, closed-door meeting focused entirely on confidential legal and land acquisition matters.
*   Key discussions included multiple active lawsuits against the City of Austin, including cases involving the Austin Police Department and city personnel.
*   Another significant item on the agenda was the land acquisition strategy for a Convention Center parking garage.
*   No public hearings were held, and no final policy decisions or actions were taken during this executive session.
